trl_rationale: Flight-model radio operated and characterised on orbit on the ISS testbed; all tested configurations met expected performance. A testbed demonstration rather than a mission system, so 7 rather than 8.

evidence.quote: All tested waveform configurations met or exceeded the expected BER performance, the SDR signal acquisition levels met the minimum acquisition criteria, the SDR input power was close to the predicted power, and the analog and digital AGC levels were as expected.
The on-orbit results were found to be very similar to the ground results, so the ground testing was determined to be a good predictor of on-orbit performance.
The SCaN Testbed was launched on July 20, 2012, and is installed on the International Space Station (ISS) (Fig. 1).

review_notes: TRL 8 arguable if a flight model operating on orbit counts as flight-qualified.
